headline: US Trade Policy and Tariff Powers Face Conflict with Democratic-Led Congress
summary: Following the US midterm elections, analysts anticipate tension between President Trump and the Democratic-controlled Congress regarding protectionist tariff powers. Key trade dynamics with partners including Canada remain constrained.
why: US trade policy and international tariffs affect global cross-border supply chains, corporate margins, and foreign trade relations.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Potential legislative friction over trade executive powers creates policy uncertainty for importers.
